scripts.start:bg: zsh -lc 'nohup node src/bot.js > bot.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo $! > bot.pid; disown; echo started $(cat bot.pid)'
scripts.stop: sh -c 'if [ -f bot.pid ] && kill -0 $(cat bot.pid) 2>/dev/null; then kill $(cat bot.pid) && echo stopped $(cat bot.pid); else echo not running; fi'
scripts.service:start: sh -c 'launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) /Users/dazhaoguo/Library/LaunchAgents/com.zapry.test-bot.plist 2>/dev/null || true; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.zapry.test-bot'
scripts.service:restart: sh -c 'launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.zapry.test-bot 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) /Users/dazhaoguo/Library/LaunchAgents/com.zapry.test-bot.plist; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.zapry.test-bot'
